title: B14 frozen-collision future-probe predictive ambiguity adjudication
purpose: Determine whether the already frozen B14 hidden-state collision pairs also exhibit future storage-response ambiguity under identical probes, without changing the coordinate, pair selection, probes, horizons, or numerical response scales.

future_probes.provenance: same probe set and horizons frozen before B14 in F-ROM1A and used in ROM1B2

starting_state_reconstruction.reference_policy: same frozen strict-first B14-qualified X1 policy

numerical_reference_scales.source: pre-ROM1 B14 ROM-0V1 and ROM-0T1Q1 only

pairwise_response.rule: two times single-trajectory scale by triangle inequality

ambiguity_rule.record_ambiguous_if: any formal storage response difference exceeds its frozen B14 pairwise Reference scale
ambiguity_rule.transfer_predictive_ambiguity_establishe: at least one frozen pair/probe/horizon record is ambiguous

next_rule.if_ambiguity_established: close Z8+G8 material transfer as predictive state-sufficiency no-go; no B14-driven coordinate enrichment; a new research cycle requires an independently designed state class and new uncontaminated transfer evaluation
next_rule.if_not_established: retain X1 non-injective state-separation no-go but do not claim predictive insufficiency; further transfer interpretation requires a separately preregistered closure-oriented study
next_rule.if_reference_unresolved: diagnose B14 Reference probe path without changing coordinate/probes
